mentions.name: Always Awake Windows Tray Utility
mentions.description: A small Windows tray utility that keeps a PC "always awake": it prevents the PC from going to sleep using a dedicated Windows API and simulates invisible mouse movements every 60 seconds so the user always appears active in apps like MS Teams. It deliberately has no options or command-line flags—just a tray icon toggled on (green) or off (orange) with a double-click. The full installer is only 100Kb, works on all Windows versions from Win7 onward, and installs without admin rights.
mentions.problem: Existing alternatives are awkward: Microsoft's similar PowerToy is full of options and command-line flags, and physical mouse jigglers are cumbersome and often produce visible mouse movements, which is annoying.
mentions.source_excerpt: This month I wrote a small Windows utility to keep a PC "always awake": prevents the PC from going to sleep (using a Windows API that exists just for that) and simulates invisible mouse movements every 60 seconds to keep apps like MS Teams happy, so that the user always appears active.
